about.description: Getaway Charters has been in business since 1995 with some of the best fishing charter boats in Orange Beach, Alabama. Located at Zekes Marina, we are only 10 minutes from Gulf Shores AL and Perdido Key FL. Two exceptional vessels (Getaway & Another Getaway) designed for unforgettable fishing experiences with one of the most popular charter companies on the Gulf of Mexico.
about.elevator_pitch: Premier deep sea and family fishing charter company in Orange Beach offering full and half-day adventures since 1995.
about.vibe: Professional, family-friendly, experienced captains and deckhands, well-maintained vessels with modern electronics and comfortable amenities
about.insider_tip: Located only 10 minutes from Gulf Shores AL and Perdido Key FL. Vessels equipped with Furuno radar, Simrad bottom machine, and Simrad chart plotter for optimal fishing conditions.
